summary: Sprint M12 Selection Console — full backend + frontend E2E testing. All 16 backend pytest cases PASSED covering: GET /selection idempotent draft creation, PATCH persistence of shortlist_ids/votes/voters/members/match_officials/notes, PATCH lock while Awaiting_MPCA_Approval, PATCH acceptance-gate (400 while Pending), submit 403 without role, submit 400 for <11 members, submit 400 for no captain, successful submit → Awaiting_MPCA_Approval + submitted_at/by, review 403 for non-secretary, approve → Approved, reject → Rejected + editable again, players seed (269 total / 250 html_console_v1 with rich stats/form/yo-yo/compliance). Frontend E2E as division-secretary → selection-console loaded → 3-column layout verified (all 22 data-testids present) → 269 pool rows → dossier drawer opened & showed career stats (FC/List A/T20 with M/Runs/Avg/SR/100_50/Wkts/BowlAvg/Econ + last-5 form) + compliance + toggle-squad btn → <11 submit blocked with alert → 11 players + no captain blocked → captain marked + submit → Awaiting_MPCA_Approval → persona switch to secretary → approve-btn/reject-btn appear → Approve → Approved. Tournaments list Select button (data-testid trn-select-<no>) navigates to /tournaments/{id}/selection correctly (35 accepted tournaments show Select). All M12 test tournaments cleaned up from MongoDB.

issues: When two tournaments share the same tournament_no (e.g. an old TEST_CapacityTournament also had TRN-2025-26-036), the data-testid 'trn-select-TRN-2025-26-036' is NOT unique — clicking picks the first-in-DOM tournament, not the intended one. Backend tournament_no generation is not enforcing uniqueness; consider adding a unique index on tournaments.tournament_no or scoping test-ids with tournament id. Impact: mostly test-env; production would have same conflict if seed re-runs.

action_items: (nice-to-have) Consider adding a unique DB index on tournaments.tournament_no to prevent duplicate-number collisions during dev-time re-seeding. Test-id collisions can be avoided by keying trn-select on tournament.id instead of tournament_no.
(soft) SelectionConsole draftMinutes() and exportCSV() were not automated but were coded correctly — main agent may want to smoke-test them manually.

(soft) No frontend regression that submit-mpca-btn is hidden for isOfficeBearer=false persona; the current gate 'persona?.body_type !== State' is inverted (State body types are hidden). This is intentional per spec (only Divisions submit), but the reviewer role visibility (approve-btn) uses isOfficeBearer AND status==='Awaiting_MPCA_Approval' — works as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/selection_console.py:31 — GET /selection does NOT gate on acceptance.status; it will create a Draft squad even for tournaments where the host hasn't accepted. Only patch/submit block via _ensure_accepted. Per spec, GET should return 400 with 'locked until host body accepts'. The frontend hides the pre-page via SelectionConsole.jsx 'Locked' gate (acceptanceOK check), so behaviour is correct end-to-end, but the pure-API contract in the spec says GET should be locked too. Currently GET is unlocked; PATCH is locked. Confirmed test_pending_tournament_selection_locked passes via PATCH gate.

backend/routes/selection_console.py — /submit gates by _DIVISION_ROLES which includes 'secretary' (MPCA Hon.Secretary). That means MPCA secretary can technically submit a division squad. Consider excluding 'secretary'/'president' from submit path, or restricting to only division-secretary/district-secretary.
backend — No DELETE /tournaments endpoint exists (405 Method Not Allowed). Test cleanup falls back to direct MongoDB deletes. Consider adding an admin DELETE for hygiene.
backend — Tournament number generation does not guarantee uniqueness across re-seed cycles; two tournaments can share TRN-2025-26-036. Add a unique index or use a monotonic sequence collection.

frontend SelectionConsole.jsx:196 — window.confirm() and window.alert() are used liberally (submit warnings, submit result, review action prompt). Consider migrating to the app's toast/modal for consistent UX.
frontend SelectionConsole.jsx:178 — inline balance calculation calls players.find twice per member per role bucket (O(N*B*M)) — could be O(N) with a Map. Not urgent for 269 players but worth noting.

frontend PlayerDossierDrawer.jsx — no data-testid on career stat rows; if you want to assert 'Career statistics header visible', currently only the drawer + close/toggle buttons carry testids. Minor testability improvement.
test_credentials: Client-side persona in localStorage.mpca_persona: division-secretary (body_code=DIV-IND, Shri Vikram Patil) for selection editing; secretary (body_code=MPCA, Shri Sanjeev Rao) for MPCA review.
seed_data_creation: 6 M12-prefixed tournaments were created during testing (M12 UnAccepted, M12 Accepted, M12 SubmitSmall, M12 SubmitNoCap, M12 SubmitOK, M12 Reject, M12 NoAwait, M12 UITest ClickThrough). ALL deleted via direct MongoDB delete at test teardown + a final sweep. Post-cleanup: 0 M12 tournaments remain. 269 players (250 html_console_v1 seed) were NOT touched — read-only in tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M12 selection console is fully working end-to-end. Backend endpoints: GET /api/tournaments/{tid}/selection (auto-creates Draft, idempotent), PATCH /api/tournaments/{tid}/selection (locked when Awaiting_MPCA_Approval / Approved; unlocked after Rejected), POST /api/tournaments/{tid}/selection/submit (400 on <11 or no captain, needs division-secretary+ role), POST /api/tournaments/{tid}/selection/review (needs secretary/president). Frontend Selection Console at /tournaments/:id/selection has all 22 required data-testids (sel-div-filter, sel-role-{TOP,MID,WK,AR,PACE,SPIN}, sel-flag-{avail,fit,clean}, sel-yoyo-min, sel-w-{form,season,fitness,exp,cond}, sel-voter-sel-*, sel-tab-{pool,shortlist,squad}, sel-search, pool-row-<id>, open-dossier-<id>, shortlist-<id>, squad-<id>, cap-<id>, vc-<id>, rm-<id>, squad-sheet, match-officials-block, official-{manager,coach,trainer,physio,umpire_1,umpire_2,scorer,referee}, warnings-block, submit-mpca-btn, approve-btn, reject-btn, sel-status, player-dossier-drawer, dossier-close-btn, dossier-toggle-squad-btn). Backend tests preserved at /app/backend/tests/test_m12_selection_console.py for regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. During initial UI exploration, the test data-testid 'trn-select-TRN-2025-26-036' matched TWO tournaments in the DOM (old TEST_CapacityTournament and new M12 UITest — both had the same tournament_no). Playwright clicked the first, which briefly showed a squad-size-1 legacy tournament. Verified by navigating directly to /tournaments/{uuid}/selection which uses the unique id — flow then worked perfectly. Root cause is backend tournament_no non-uniqueness (see design_issues).
